capabilities: Import .zkn3 archives as Markdown notes with position-based file names
Convert keywords into a keywords property and markup into Markdown
Preview a report of missing link targets, unsupported markup and file conflicts
Convert note links, cross-references and note sequences into wiki links and sections
Compare two archives to list added, changed and removed notes (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a Zettelkasten workflow tool; it only converts Zettelkasten 3 archive files into Markdown notes.
extras: Freemium: core import is free; Pro rules and archive comparison need a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship ($5/month or $15 once). Pro requires sign-in via the GitHub device flow, though the plugin sends no note content and works offline for up to 14 days after a check. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. After minor or major updates it opens a What's new tab in the background that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; it can be turned off in Settings. The import does not copy attachments, images, bookmarks, outlines or the BibTeX file. Limits: 20 MiB archive, 100 MiB expanded data, and only version 3.8 archives are accepted.
problem: Obsidian cannot read Zettelkasten 3 archive files, so users of that program have no direct path to move their notes into a vault.

relations.evidence: Convert a version 3.8 Zettelkasten 3 archive (a .zkn3 file) into Markdown notes.

summary: Imports Zettelkasten 3 (.zkn3) archives into a vault as Markdown notes with keywords, note links, cross-references and note sequences.
